title: Handle billing unavailability during submission
objective: Confirm the defined failure and retry behavior when billing is unavailable, while exposing the undefined post-failure state.
preconditions: A synthetic order exists in DRAFT state.
The billing service is unavailable in the test environment.

test_data.name: draft order
test_data.description: A synthetic DRAFT order eligible for submission.

test_data.name: dependency state
test_data.description: Billing service unavailable through an approved test-environment control.

steps.action: Submit the DRAFT order while the billing service is unavailable.
steps.expected_result: Submission does not complete and a retry action is available; the resulting order state and retained data require clarification.

cleanup: Restore the billing service test control and remove the synthetic order after recording its observed state.
notes: The known failure and retry behavior is testable, but ORD-006 does not define the final order state or partial-data handling.
